pages.title: Where to look
pages.text: Look for the encounter at: Skeletosaurus Nest.

pages.title: Locator search
pages.text: Use this encounter’s locator in the Nether. It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat.

pages.title: Defense and response
pages.text: Sleep blocks normal hits. Direct damage attributed to thrown potions and area-effect clouds, burning and falling is rejected separately. Prepare healing and melee equipment; leave the frontal sector on a wind-up instead of trading hits.

pages.title: Ordinary combat
pages.text: This profile does not use hosted preparation. Fight it normally rather than looking for Start. Defeating this enemy contributes to world-tier progression.

pages.title: Loot and use
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Dinosaur Bone. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.

pages.title: Next step
pages.text: This victory belongs to the branch for: Luxtructosaurus. The other victories in that branch are also required. Sibling prerequisite encounters can be completed in any order.
